nodes.name: When Called By Agent
nodes.notes: Agent contract: Envelope v1.0. Called by WF-03 for EXTRACTED leads.

parameters.query:
SELECT l.lead_id, l.business_id, l.trace_id,
       e.contact_name, e.contact_email, e.company, e.budget_value, e.budget_currency,
       e.product_interest, e.urgency, e.location,
       b.config,
       (SELECT min(p.price) FROM vaibhavcapstone_products p
        WHERE p.business_id = l.business_id AND p.stock_qty > 0) AS min_price
FROM vaibhavcapstone_leads l
JOIN vaibhavcapstone_extractions e USING (lead_id)
JOIN vaibhavcapstone_businesses b ON b.business_id = l.business_id
WHERE l.lead_id = $1 AND l.status = 'EXTRACTED';

nodes.name: Assemble Qualification
nodes.notes: If Gemini output is unusable, fall back to the rubric breakdown as reasons - qualification never blocks on the LLM.

parameters.query:
WITH p AS (SELECT $1::text lead, $2::text biz, $3::text trc, $4::int score, $5::text band, $6::jsonb reasons, $7::jsonb breakdown),
q AS (INSERT INTO vaibhavcapstone_qualifications (lead_id, business_id, score, band, reasons)
  SELECT lead, biz, score, band, jsonb_build_object('reasons', reasons, 'rubric', breakdown) FROM p
  ON CONFLICT (lead_id) DO UPDATE SET score = EXCLUDED.score, band = EXCLUDED.band, reasons = EXCLUDED.reasons
  RETURNING lead_id),
u AS (UPDATE vaibhavcapstone_leads SET status = 'QUALIFIED', updated_at = now()
  WHERE lead_id = (SELECT lead FROM p) AND status = 'EXTRACTED' RETURNING status),
ev AS (INSERT INTO vaibhavcapstone_events (business_id, lead_id, trace_id, agent, action, actor, detail)
  SELECT biz, lead, trc, 'qualifier', 'LEAD_QUALIFIED', 'system',
    jsonb_build_object('score', score, 'band', band) FROM p RETURNING event_id)
SELECT (SELECT lead FROM p) AS lead_id, (SELECT band FROM p) AS band, (SELECT score FROM p) AS score;

nodes.name: LLM Result qualifier_reasons
nodes.notes: Merge point: normalizes Gemini or OpenAI responses to one shape; __model/__fallback feed telemetry.

parameters.content:
## Deciding how promising this enquiry is

Every enquiry gets a score out of 100 and lands in one of three buckets — hot, warm or cold — so the team knows what to chase first.

The important part, and the thing most people get wrong: **the score is worked out by arithmetic, not by the AI.** The business's own settings decide what earns points. The AI is only asked to put the result into a sentence a person can read.

### Score it — by arithmetic

**Check the job ticket**, then fetch the enquiry along with this business's own scoring settings.

**Add up the points.** Every rule is a plain sum: a stated budget earns points, a named contact earns points, a clear product interest earns points, real urgency earns points. A budget below everything in the catalogue *loses* points. Add it up, compare against this business's own thresholds, and out comes hot, warm or cold.

Two businesses can score the very same email differently, because each brings its own weights and thresholds. Nothing here is wired to one company.

### Ask the AI to explain the score — not to set it

By the time we get here the score already exists. The AI's only job is to turn the arithmetic into a readable line or two for whoever picks the lead up.

**Ask Google's AI**, with OpenAI standing by if Google fails, and both answers flattened into one shape.

**If the AI says nothing useful, it doesn't matter.** The reasons fall back to the arithmetic itself — "stated budget (+25), clear product interest (+20)". The score is never blocked, delayed or changed by the AI being unavailable.

**The call is recorded** with its exact tokens and cost, like every other.

### Save it, and move on

**Write the band, the score and the reasons** onto the enquiry's record, and move it to its next stage.

**Write the next job ticket** and call the workflow that matches real products to the enquiry.

Cold leads travel the same road as hot ones — scored, recorded, passed along. Nothing is thrown away here; it's just put in order.

## Why the AI doesn't get to score

Ask an AI to rate a lead and it will cheerfully give you a different answer for the same email tomorrow.

So it doesn't get the job. The score comes from arithmetic the business controls and can inspect. The AI writes the explanation — and if it fails, the arithmetic explains itself.

**The same email always scores the same. 85.7% agreement with the human labels, and never once was a hot lead called cold.**
